Class GroveDht22

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveDht22
All Implemented Interfaces:
SampleProvider, Thermometer
public final class GroveDht22 extends Object implements Thermometer, SampleProvider
Reads Seeed's Grove Temperature and Humidity Sensor Pro using its DHT22 (AM2302) frame format. The first two bytes contain humidity in tenths of a percent and the next two contain temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius. The caller owns and reuses both buffers; this driver allocates nothing.

Allow at least two seconds between readings. A valid frame's checksum alone does not identify the physical sensor, but DHT22-format readings should also be within its measurement range.

  • Method Details

    • read

      public boolean read(int signalPin, int[] reading, int readingLength, int[] frame, int frameLength)
      Reads one frame using a caller-owned five-int raw frame buffer. Returns false for incomplete, corrupt or out-of-range frames, leaving reading unchanged in those cases. The raw frame is still available when all 40 bits arrived but validation failed.
      Parameters:
      signalPin - digital Grove signal pin
      reading - caller-owned temperature/humidity result in tenths
      readingLength - writable result slots, at least READING_LENGTH
      frame - caller-owned raw frame buffer
      frameLength - writable frame slots, at least FRAME_LENGTH
      Returns:
      whether a plausible, checksum-valid DHT22 frame was read
